To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the amyloid forming peptide hIAPP initially develops ordered structure in the region that is close to a loop in the mature fibril, followed by the formation of the 1 ^{st} β-sheet, and finally the formation of the second parallel β-sheet.
we have measured the kinetics and structure of the aggregation pathway for the 37-resident polypeptide associated to type II diabetes, the human amyloid polypeptides.
we have measured the kinetics of secondary structure development in the human amylin protein during amyloid formation with site-specific resolution using 2-dimensional infrared spectroscopy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods for studying protein folding and aggregation.
the development of new methods for studying amyloid aggregation and with the application of these methods to understanding the aggregation process of human islet amyloids.
the molecular mechanisms of amyloid formation and the development of new methods for probing the aggregation pathway.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hIAPP aggregation pathway proceeds via an initial formation of an ordered structure in the loop region, which is then extended to form the parallel β-sheets.
this work shows the development of secondary structure during amyloid formation with the resolution of individual residues.
this study provides the first detailed view of amyloid fibril formation in which the kinetics and the structural development at 6 different sites along the chain of hIAPP are monitored in real-time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new method to study the kinetics of amyloid formation and applied it to hIAPP to provide a detailed view of how amyloid fibrils form.
hIAPP forms a fibril with the N-terminus forming the first parallel β-sheet followed by formation of a parallel β-sheet with the C-terminus.

we are able to define the pathway of amyloids by using a combination of 2-dimensional IR spectroscopy, site-specific isotope-labeling, and a recently developed method for analyzing 2-dimensional IR data called 2D-IR/2D-IR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the formation of the parallel β-sheets is not the first step in the amyloid aggregation pathway.
the amyloid formation pathway of hIAP is similar to other proteins that form β-sheets.
the formation of the parallel β-sheet is not a single step but is a multi-step process.
